note: How long the Autos wait for the robot before moving on: a wait ends when its sensor says so (IntakeFull, Empty) or at this limit. Generous until each is timed on the real robot; tools/auto-routes/limits.py reads them, and TeamCode/autos/README.md says how to change one. Game timing (when a TIP comes, when a spill lands) is not here.

flowerS.note: a FLOWER's 4 with the extractor seated. The simulator takes 1.66-1.68 s; time the real extractor (10 tries) and set this a little above the slowest. Without a full sensor this is the whole wait: 1.8 s instead of 3.0 is worth TIP 3 on R-Quals (doc/sensing-study.md)

gardenS.note: the GARDEN's 4 from GARDEN_IN. Simulator 1.2-1.5 s

catchS.note: standing at a catch spot after a TIP, for pieces that roll in. Mostly runs to the limit in the simulator: it is a wait for the spill, not for the intake

fireFirstS.note: the Auto's first fire: spin-up, turret slew and 4 shots. Simulator 2.6 s from the right start, 0.65 s once aimed at FAR_FLOWER_TURN. Time it from PLAY

fireS.note: any later fire of up to 4 pieces, aimed. Simulator 0.65-1.1 s (0.2 s a shot). Without an empty sensor this is the whole wait
